definitions: The hard fibrous material that forms the main substance of the trunk or branches of a tree or shrub, used for fuel or as a building material.
An area of land, smaller than a forest, that is covered with growing trees.
A golf club with a large head, typically made of wood or metal, used for hitting long shots.
A cask or barrel, especially one for wine.
The material of which the frame of a boat is made.
examples: The table is made of solid wood.
We went for a walk in the wood.
He used a wood to drive the ball.
The wood of the ship was rotting.
